records.text: Nick said he felt federal agents were trying to implant a one-shot memory in witnesses by repeatedly telling them they had heard one shot.
records.speaker: Nick (on-the-ground assistant; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: And what's really interesting is I told you guys already about Nick (on-the-ground assistant; surname unverified), who has been assisting me on the ground. And one of the first things he said to me was that I felt like they were coming around—the feds were coming around—and they were trying to implant memories into our heads. So he was like, "I felt like there were these people walking around that we didn't recognize, and they were like, 'You heard one shot. You heard—we heard one shot. We heard one shot.'" And he's like, "I know that sounds weird and conspiratorial, but it seems like they were trying to make us believe that this is what we heard."
